resolved.title: 房间面积
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你需要为一个长方形的房间地板购买油漆，需要知道房间面积。

现在，给定的程序，输入房间的**长度**和**宽度**。
 
请完善程序，计算并输出该房间的**面积**。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Basic Arithmetic[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You need to buy paint for the floor of a rectangular room.
The given program takes the room's [b]length [/b]and [b]width [/b]as input.
 
[b]Task
[/b]Complete the program to calculate and output the [b]area [/b]of the room.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5.4
2.3
[b]
Sample Output[/b]
12.42 

[b]Hint[/b]
To calculate the area, multiply the length by the width. In this case 5.4*2.3=12.42. 

[note]Use the [b]* operator[/b] to perform multiplication.[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Division[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The division operator divides the first operand by the second. Any remainder is dropped in order to return an integer value.
[s0l0!-header][b]Example: [/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="cpp" codeId="4937"]int x = 10 / 3;
cout << x;
[/code]
If one or both of the operands are floating point values, the division operator performs floating point division.

[note]Dividing by 0 will crash your program.[/note]

resolved.title: 运算符优先级
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Operator Precedence [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Parentheses force the operations to have higher precedence. If there are parenthetical expressions nested within one another, the expression within the innermost parentheses is evaluated first. 
[note]If none of the expressions are in parentheses, [b]multiplicative [/b](multiplication, division, modulus) operators will be evaluated before [b]additive [/b](addition, subtraction) operators.[/note]
